review_note: silhouettes accepted for gameplay readability; surface treatment must be repainted to the HYPERSONIC 1995-1998 authored-pixel art direction before final acceptance

visual_contract.boss_rule: physically engineered machine silhouettes with exposed functional modules; no alien saucers or decorative neon
visual_contract.materials: cold blue-gray structure, pale service armour, graphite machinery, restrained cyan logic cores and amber industrial apertures

process.orientation: orthographic top-down, attack front facing down toward player
process.alpha_review: 20 percent source-alpha threshold and battlefield-plate review; no matte halo
process.palette: one shared 31-colour RGB palette with source alpha restored after remap
